comparison_ref.description: Name of the reference this claim compares against, e.g. 'CAMELS-US v1.2'. Set it whenever the claim says the result differs from, agrees with or is biased against a reference: it makes the claim a comparison claim, so supported/weakly_supported is refused when the producer's reference_comparison says can_claim_difference=false, or when the cited CI scope excludes forcing_product.
